title: Finite-source exact cohomology segment for a projective embedding
statement: Let $T$ be affine with $A=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ Noetherian [def-pc-scheme], $N$ a finite coordinate type and $j:Y\hookrightarrow P=\mathbb P(N;T)$ a closed immersion [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change, def-weil-closed-immersion]. For a quasi-coherent finitely presented module $F$ on $Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $q\in\mathbb N$, there exist a quasi-coherent finitely presented module $K$ on $P$, a finite $A$-module $V$, and $A$-linear maps $V\to H^q(Y,F)\to H^{q+1}(P,K)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] exact at the middle term. The action on $H^q(Y,F)$ is restricted along $(j\circ\pi)^\sharp$ and that on $H^{q+1}(P,K)$ along $\pi^\sharp$. No finiteness assumption or conclusion is imposed on the last term.

proof.text: Obtain the additive cohomology comparison from nonempty_functorH_iso_pushforwardAb_of_isAffineHom. Naturality with respect to smulHom, the identity pushforward_map_smulHom, and Hom.comp_appTop show that this comparison is Gamma(T,O)-linear for the exact specified restricted actions. This is the private proved helper pushforward_cohomology_linearEquiv.

Apply exists_projective_finite_cohomology_presentation to N, j, F, q. It supplies E, an epimorphism phi:E->j_*F, a coherent kernel K, and finite H^q(E) over the base. Form the short exact kernel sequence using ShortComplex.exact_kernel phi.

source.place: Tag 01YS, proof of Lemma 30.14.1 (1) and (3); Tag 01XT, Lemma 30.8.1

proof.text: Use the proved source API H.ker_delta_eq_range_map_g (Lean H.ker_δ_eq_range_map_g) for the short exact kernel sequence, and H.delta_smul (Lean H.δ_smul) to obtain the connecting map linearly over base sections. This API is the Ext covariant boundary exactness applied to the exact forgetful functor to abelian sheaves; its scalar linearity is extClass_naturality applied to the endomorphism given by multiplication on all three sheaves. Set V to the ModuleCat object H^q(E). Compose H.map phi with the inverse of the proved pushforward equivalence, and compose the connecting map with its forward direction. For x in H^q(F), boundary(e(x))=0 iff there exists y with H.map phi y=e(x), iff there exists y with e^{-1}(H.map phi y)=x, using the two inverse identities. These are the delivered exact maps. No finiteness of H^(q+1)(K) is used.

proof_origin.note: U3 compiled the exact kernel sequence, connecting-map linearity, affine pushforward scalar naturality, and exactness transport; only the finite-cohomology projective presentation is split off.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_projective_finite_source_cohomology_segment
    {Y T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
    (N : Type u) [Finite N] (j : Y ⟶ ℙ(N; T)) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (F.H q) :=
      Module.compHom _ (j ≫ (ℙ(N; T) ↘ T)).appTop.hom
    ∃ (K : (ℙ(N; T)).Modules) (_ : K.IsQuasicoherent) (_ : K.IsFinitePresentation),
      letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (K.H (q + 1)) :=
        Module.compHom _ (ℙ(N; T) ↘ T).appTop.hom
      ∃ (V : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(T, ⊤)) (_ : Module.Finite Γ(T, ⊤) V)
        (a : V →ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)] F.H q) (b : F.H q →ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)] K.H (q + 1)),
        Function.Exact a b
